title: Register a name
goal: Make name 42 resolve to address A (100).

steps.say: Queue the approved Insert; no NFT exists yet.
Fold the request; the application holds one representative NFT and resolves to address A.

title: Two requests, one name
goal: Fold one Insert and withdraw the competing request with separate approval.

steps.say: Queue the first approved Insert.
Queue a competing Insert for address B.
Fold the first request; the second remains pending.
Mint a separate approval bound to the competing request and exact refund.
Withdraw the competing Insert; address A remains live.

forks.title: Try folding both: the entire batch is refused

steps.say: The second item sees the first item’s active key. Neither item commits.

title: Cancel a pending Insert
goal: Remove the request before it creates a representative NFT.

steps.say: Queue an approved Insert.
Approve this request’s exact withdrawal and refund.
Withdraw the pending Insert. The name is still absent.

title: Change address A to B
goal: Use application approval to change the address while keeping the same representative.

steps.say: Queue the approved Insert; no NFT exists yet.
Fold the request; the application holds one representative NFT and resolves to address A.
The application accepts the exact successor; the name now resolves to B (200).
Without accepted application evidence, the address cannot change.

title: Retire the name
goal: Queue Update, observe pending resolution, then complete retirement.

steps.say: Queue the approved Insert; no NFT exists yet.
Fold the request; the application holds one representative NFT and resolves to address A.
Application-approved Update moves the NFT into request custody. Resolution is pending.
Fold Update; burn the NFT. The name is retired and occupied.

title: Delete the name
goal: Queue Delete and make the name absent again.

steps.say: Queue the approved Insert; no NFT exists yet.
Fold the request; the application holds one representative NFT and resolves to address A.
Application-approved Delete moves the NFT to request custody.
Fold Delete; the NFT burns, the name is absent, and its incarnation increases.
Terminal custody can leave only through completion.

title: Delete and reinsert in a batch
goal: Observe successive Delete then Insert effects with net zero representative mint.

steps.say: Queue the approved Insert; no NFT exists yet.
Fold the request; the application holds one representative NFT and resolves to address A.
Queue Delete.
Queue Insert approved for the next incarnation.
Atomic batch: Delete removes the old entry, then Insert installs address B. Logical burn and mint cancel.
A completed request is unavailable and cannot be replayed.

title: An outsider cannot forge origin
goal: Show an outsider’s request being refused at the authenticated-origin boundary.

steps.say: An outsider can post a request; the model marks its origin unauthenticated.
Folding the outsider request is refused: no representative is minted.
